title: W1770 Triflex
seo_title: W1770 Triflex · Super Walter — Award-winning seeder at CITA 2025
seo_description: W1770 Triflex: Super Walter seeder with a triple-articulated frame, Air Drill metering and ISOBUS monitoring. CITA 2025 Innovation Award.
og_description: Triflex frame, Air Drill and ISOBUS. The seeder that won the CITA 2025 Award.
hero_image_alt: Super Walter W1770 seeder at work at sunset in a stubble field
lead: Triple-articulated folding frame and Air Drill discs. The answer when every day of seeding counts.
ficha_heading: The seeder designed so every seed finds its place, on any terrain.
ficha_image_alt: Tractor with a Super Walter seeder working a hillside at sunset

features.title: Section control
features.text: The machine automatically shuts off rows that have already been seeded, avoiding overlap and lowering the cost per hectare.

features.title: Air Drill metering
features.text: Precise, steady pneumatic distribution of seed and fertilizer, even at high travel speeds.

features.title: ISOBUS monitoring
features.text: Full control from the cab: density, inputs and the performance of each unit in real time.

features.title: Triflex frame
features.text: Triple articulation that follows the terrain and keeps seeding depth even across the full working width.

benefits_heading: An innovation award you can feel in the field.

benefits.title: Proven robustness
benefits.text: Built to last season after season, with spare parts available across the country.

benefits.title: Real precision
benefits.text: Seeding uniformity that translates into better emergence and higher yield per hectare.

benefits.title: Input efficiency
benefits.text: Section control and precise metering: every seed and every kilo of fertilizer exactly where it belongs.

benefits.title: Close to you
benefits.text: Argentine-made, with direct support and a dealer network that knows your area.
